profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at G2O
profile.summary:
I'm a frontend focused software developer, with a special interest in ADA and WCAG compliance. I believe a more accessible web is a better web.

I graduated from Miami University in 2019, obtaining a BS in Computer Science, with a minor in History.
